title: Adapter manifest.json
description: An adapter's contract (SPEC.md §6). Built-ins embed theirs; external adapters ship it next to the `run` executable in ~/.gtme/adapters/<name>/. Derived from internal/adapters.Manifest, which decodes with DisallowUnknownFields — hence additionalProperties: false here.

id.description: Adapter id, e.g. 'harvest/profile'. Provenance written to field_values.source is '<id>@<version>'.

version.description: Manifest version; part of the provenance string.

role.description: What the adapter does in a pipeline. Only enrich/verify are cache-skippable (SPEC.md §7).

entity_type.description: 'person' | 'company' (extensible), or '*' for an entity-agnostic adapter (SPEC.md §6, ADR-033): its steps take the pipeline's entity type, and its static needs/provides are validated against that type at plan time. A source may not declare '*'.

needs.description: JSON Schema for the projection the runner builds and hands in. `needs.required` is what the planner checks (SPEC.md §7). An object with additionalProperties:true and no properties is the needs-all wildcard. Dynamic needs (SPEC.md §6, ADR-019): the string 'dynamic', or an object carrying 'dynamic': true whose remaining keys are an ordinary JSON Schema acting as the always-required static floor — effective needs are then floor ∪ config-derived (`uses:` for filter/compose, `variables:` values for deliver). Property names in a static schema must be registry-canonical for the entity_type or vendor-namespaced (SPEC.md §4a).

provides.description: JSON Schema for the fields the adapter produces. Output RECORD fields are validated against it before the ledger write (SPEC.md §5), and canonical fields additionally against the registry's type/enum/normalized form (SPEC.md §4a). Property names must be registry-canonical for the entity_type or vendor-namespaced.

credentials.description: Env var names the runner MUST inject. A missing one is a plan-time error (SPEC.md §6).

credentials_optional.description: Injected when present, never blocks a plan (SPEC.md §6). Used by adapters that can work several ways, e.g. an AI step with a local engine.

config_schema.description: JSON Schema for the step's `with:` block.

freshness_days.description: Default cache window for the fields this adapter provides; overridable per step with `cache:` (SPEC.md §6, §9).

emits_key_fields.description: Sources only: which output fields the runner should build the identity key from (SPEC.md §6).

cost_estimate_usd.description: Static per-record cost estimate. `gtme plan` prints '?' when absent (SPEC.md §7).

batch.description: Marks adapters the runner must feed in batches — the AI steps — one invocation per batch_size records (SPEC.md §6, §9).

keep_payloads.description: ADR-030: whether raw responses this adapter attaches to its RECORDs (SPEC.md §5) are retained in the payloads cache tier. Default true; steps may override with keep_payloads: false in config.

attests.description: ADR-036, deliver adapters only: after a successful create the adapter re-reads the target and emits an ATTEST per record (SPEC.md §5) — confirmed | contradicted | inconclusive. Absent, every delivery stays `accepted` and is reported inconclusive (the honest default).

preflights.description: PROPOSED (ADR-040), deliver adapters only: the adapter can check the live target against what a step is about to send (SPEC.md §5 PREFLIGHT) — read-only, at --dry-run and arm time. Absent, no preflight runs.

payload_ttl_days.description: ADR-030: retention window for this adapter's payloads (default 90). 0 means no expiry — kept until an explicit gtme vacuum decision.
